messages:
maria (eng-arch): quick RFC follow-up — we need to pick a path for airgapped upgrades: sidecar verifier + stream-only deltas vs full-agent apply that replaces staged images. goal: minimize blast radius and operator friction. thoughts?
ajay (eng-sre): prefer sidecar verifier if it avoids a full agent restart. ops teams dread mass-reboots in airgapped sites. can we do atomic switch without reboot? :grimacing:
lucy (eng-security): security tradeoff: sidecar reduces attack surface during apply, but verifying-only means we still trust the uploader to create correct delta. need signed, timestamped manifests and CRL for revocations. HSM/KMS key rotation path is required.
sam (eng-runtime): runtime concerns: streaming-only deltas must support block-level patching for model shards and preserve KV cache offsets. otherwise warm-start will be broken and latency spikes on first requests. also need a consistent activation marker update flow.
maria (eng-arch): proposal sketch: 1) signer creates a signed manifest.json with entries: {"bundle_id","parts":[],"signature"} 2) agent-side sidecar validates signatures and writes parts to staging. Activation is a separate, operator-triggered step that performs an atomic swap by moving symlinks and updating the activation marker file.
lucy (eng-security): operator-triggered activation is good. add requirement: activation must include signed activation intent signed by operator key (separate from build signer). prevents supply-chain forged activations.
ajay (eng-sre): operationally we want automatic canary too. can we do: sidecar stages -> automatic canary on local test harness -> if pass auto-activate, else hold for manual review?
sam (eng-runtime): canary is fine but tests must be hermetic and fast. propose a two-step: smoke tests (process start, inference sanity, KV cache warm) then traffic-shift limited to 1% via local router for 10m before full switch. That requires router hooks and rollout-state stored locally.
kai (product): SLA question — customers want maximum upgrade window of 4 hours and telemetry on retries. can we ensure staging + canary fits that target even on slow links? some customers still have 10Mbps links and TB-sized models.
maria (eng-arch): for slow links we support content-addressed chunking + resume. delta algorithm should be prioritized to send small critical files first (tokenizer, config, small weights subsets) so canary runs earlier. we can surface progress to console.
lucy (eng-security): also add an offline verification mode that can run purely from USB seed. seed will include manifest + signatures + blind-checksums so airgapped sites can accept physical handoff. ensure manual key ceremony documented.
ajay (eng-sre): one more ops note: must avoid partial-activation scenarios where some replicas activate and others don't. activation should be a lease-based operation: sidecar acquires activation lease, writes activation marker, notifies local router to drain/flip. if lease fails, roll back staging.
sam (eng-runtime): implementation detail: activation marker should be versioned and include KV cache invalidation vector, e.g. "activation_version: 2026-03-21T15:00Z, kv_epoch: 4821". router listens for that and decides to drop caches gracefully.
maria (eng-arch): outstanding decisions we need from this thread: - operator-keyed activation required? (Y/N) - enforce automatic canary by default? (Y/N) - support USB seed workflow as first-class? (Y/N) please react or reply with Y/N + short note.
kai (product): Y (operator activation), Y (canary default but opt-out), Y (USB seed). prioritize UX for airgapped customers in console docs.
lucy (eng-security): Y (operator activation), N (canary default should be opt-in for high-security customers), Y (USB seed). also require HSM-backed operator keys for enterprise.
ajay (eng-sre): Y, Y, Y. add retention for previous N=2 bundles for quick rollbacks.
sam (eng-runtime): Y, Y, Y but limit default canary duration to 5m for tiny sites. leave override.
maria (eng-arch): thanks — collating. i'll update the RFC with: signed manifest + operator activation intent, default canary on with opts, chunked prioritized deltas, resumeable transfer, USB-seed cookbook, activation lease semantics, KV epoch marker. i'll post a follow-up with sequence diagrams and a minimal state machine.
upgrade-bot: canary-run: node-phi-2 passed smoke tests (3/3). auto-activation pending operator intent. :party_parrot:
